title: Carpet Cleaning Checklist
subtitle: Residential Carpet Cleaning: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Carpet Cleaning Checklist covers carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path. The carpet service coordinator records Residential Carpet Cleaning criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Carpet Cleaning Checklist keeps Residential Carpet Cleaning exceptions visible until the carpet service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Carpet Cleaning Checklist at residence, room, stair, furniture area, entry path, and drying zone. Document carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path identity before Residential Carpet Cleaning begins. Compare carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path findings with stated Residential Carpet Cleaning criteria; route unresolved Residential Carpet Cleaning issues to cleaning quality reviewer.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential Carpet Cleaning, identify responsible parties, residence, room, stair, furniture area, entry path, and drying zone, and the linked carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path source.

fields.label: Room, area, carpet type, and approximate size
Stain history, prior treatment, pet condition, and requested result

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Carpet Cleaning facts for carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Residential Carpet Cleaning inspection checks
items: Fiber, colorfastness, wear, seam, backing, and pre-existing damage
Stain type, location, age, and prior chemical use
Furniture, electronics, floor transition, and protected surface
Vacuum, precondition, agitation, extraction, and spot-treatment step
Moisture removal, airflow, drying, and access restriction

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Residential Carpet Cleaning finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Carpet Service Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Fiber, dye, backing, or adhesive compatibility concern
Damage or stain cannot be safely improved
Drying or access control cannot be maintained
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Carpet Cleaning when contamination, compatibility, damage, drying, or safe-access concern remains. Retain the available Residential Carpet Cleaning proof and route unresolved carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path scope to carpet service coordinator.
